lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple high-luminance circular clusters are arranged in vertical columns across the central visible flank. Centroids are spaced in a staggered grid pattern with roughly uniform inter-blob distances in the mid-flank region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of higher pixel intensity intersect with high-luminance blobs, creating a grid-like appearance where blobs serve as intersection nodes, particularly visible in the posterior-mid-flank area.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal feature is visible in the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp luminance transition with a light dorsal edge and a shadowed ventral edge, following a linear path toward the posterior.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The visible portion of the first dorsal fin contains a localized group of approximately 6-8 high-luminance blobs. These spots are distributed primarily along the base and mid-section of the fin silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin, visible extending ventrally, displays a high density of smaller-diameter high-luminance spots compared to those on the primary lateral body wall.
